title: Convex Low-resource Accent-Robust Language Detection in Speech Recognition

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language detection accuracy, Word Error Rate (WER), and Character Error Rate (CER) of Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models across diverse regional dialects and accented speech using curated multilingual speech datasets.
Measuring the English-centric performance disparities and cross-lingual misclassification rates in baseline ASR models when processing low-resource languages and multicultural speech.
